correctness.rationale: From the actual theta-graph RESULT.md and verifying its finite subset checker: deleting target edge e leaves endpoint connectivity iff every other edge of its own terminal path AND every edge of at least one other full path has appeared. Poissonization gives independent edge states with x=1-exp(-t/N), so E_i=N integral_0^1 [1-x^(ell_i-1)(1-product_{j != i}(1-x^ell_j))] dx, yielding the given rational sum. Difference E_j-E_i=N integral (x^(ell_i-1)-x^(ell_j-1))(1-product_{k != i,j}(1-x^ell_k)) dx, strictly signed by lengths when r>=3. All equal yields rank r*ell-r+1. At r=2 the difference is zero: sharp boundary. Independently enumerated all subsets for (2,3,4), exact fractions E=(67/10,242/35,101/14) by paths, matching theory; finite tests are corroboration only.
